results.title: Unemployment shocks and material deprivation in the European ...
results.content: # Unemployment shocks and material deprivation in the European Union: A synthetic control approach. This paper proposes a new definition of an unemployment shock focusing on EU countries. In the countries where there was an unemployment shock a significant increase in material deprivation occurred. The results refute the assumption of a low sensitivity of material deprivation to changes in the economic cycle. This paper analyzes how material deprivation responds to drastic changes in unemployment levels. We use this approach to identify the impact of unemployment shocks on material deprivation and conduct different sensitivity analyses to test the results. We find that contrary to the traditional assumption of the low sensitivity of material deprivation measures to changes in the economic cycle, unemployment shocks have a significant and rapid impact on material deprivation. This conclusion holds even when extending the period of analysis, changing the indicator of material deprivation, or modifying the definition of unemployment shock.
